ravengard-plus.config.title: Ravengard Plus
ravengard-plus.config.crown_value_overla: Draw an item's Crown value in the upper-left corner while an inventory or container is open. Enabled by default.
ravengard-plus.config.inventory_total.de: Show the total Crown value of your player inventory below the ability slots.
When your inventory is full, highlight its cheapest item and mute container items that are not worth replacing it with.
ravengard-plus.config.crown_replacement_: Let healing consumables such as bandages be suggested for replacement. Off keeps them out of the comparison.

Hover over an item in a container and press the ignore key (H by default) so it's never highlighted for replacement. Press it again to undo. The item's tooltip shows the key and whether it's ignored. Clear brings back every ignored item.
ravengard-plus.config.most_valuable_high: In any container other than your inventory, highlight the item with the highest Crown value, so you know what to take. Works whether or not your inventory is full. Ties are all highlighted.
ravengard-plus.ignored_item.hint: Press %s to ignore in replacement hints
ravengard-plus.ignored_item.ignored: Ignored in replacement hints. Press %s to undo
ravengard-plus.config.armor_upgrade_indi: Mark the best equippable armor for each slot. Armor for other classes are ignored.
ravengard-plus.config.accessory_upgrades: Highlight the strongest accessory for each matching slot.
ravengard-plus.config.accessory_upgrade_: Mark the strongest accessory for each matching slot.
Configure cooldown timers and expiry sounds for abilities.
ravengard-plus.config.ability_cooldown_e: Track abilities after the game confirms their use in chat.
ravengard-plus.config.ability_cooldown_s: Scale the timer text from 50% to 150%.
Play a sound when an ability cooldown finishes.
Choose any registered Minecraft sound event.
Improve entity visibility while preserving the world's normal lighting.
ravengard-plus.config.entity_full_bright: Render every entity at maximum brightness while leaving the world lighting unchanged.
ravengard-plus.config.teammate_glow_colo: Color each glowing teammate like their marker on the minimap, so you can tell who is who.
Show a waypoint at the center of the map during games, with the distance to it.
ravengard-plus.config.map_center_marker_: How solid the center waypoint looks. Lower it if the marker covers too much of the view.
ravengard-plus.config.doors.description: Point out dungeon doors in the world.
ravengard-plus.config.door_indicators.de: Show where nearby doors are, even through walls.
ravengard-plus.config.door_indicator_sty: Marker shows a waypoint over the door. Glow outlines the door instead.
ravengard-plus.config.door_indicator_ran: Only doors within this many blocks are indicated.
ravengard-plus.config.door_color.descrip: Color used for the door's marker or glow.
ravengard-plus.config.door_marker_opacit: How solid door markers look. Only applies to the marker style.
ravengard-plus.config.pings.description: Point things out to your team with one key.
ravengard-plus.config.pings_enabled.desc: Tap the ping key to tell your team what you're looking at, or hold it and pick a message from the wheel. Pings go to team chat with the spot's coordinates. Teammates with the mod get a marker there for a few seconds and don't see the coordinates in chat. Only works during games.
ravengard-plus.config.ping_duration.desc: How long a ping marker stays up, up to 10 seconds. It fades out during the last second.
ravengard-plus.config.ping_marker_opacit: How solid ping markers look, for your pings and your teammates'.
ravengard-plus.config.ping_sound.descrip: Play a sound when you or a teammate pings.
